gen-fs-pencerio-fs-synonym: Synonym draws a plain sans stripe of constant ink with generous curve openings, pleasant company for a paragraph. Pencerio's clenched calligraphic script against that open body is the whole appeal.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-glegoo: Pramukh Rounded bunches its glyphs tight, with bowls tipped open like a ladle. Glegoo loosens things up with big counters, wide unclosed curves and a tall lowercase; a slightly larger body size would help.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-noticia-text: Pramukh Rounded packs its letters close, tight enough that the ascenders barely clear. Noticia Text gives each curve a big visible entrance and fills most of its height, so slightly larger body text would suit it.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-piazzolla: Pramukh Rounded sits tight and friendly up top. Piazzolla has lowercase nearly matching its capitals and an e opened like a pried clasp, which lets the serif relax beneath the tightly packed heading.
gen-fs-rosaline-fs-amulya: Luxurious and understated, Rosaline tugs sharp bright edges against fat dark stems, flowing like pen-written letters. Amulya leaves generous gaps in its curves, which makes a couple of lines feel modern.
gen-fs-rosaline-fs-plein: Rosaline writes hairline entry strokes straight into fat black stems, luxurious but understated. Plein follows with a clear channel into each round letter, plain sans work that stays reliable, best for a few lines.
gen-fs-rosaline-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans has wide gaps between curve ends and stems, with no hairlines to squint at in small sizes. And Rosaline's fine hairlines against massive stems are too fussy to carry pages of text.
gen-fs-rosaline-fs-synonym: Flourish meets order: Rosaline's closed, flowing letters rest over Synonym's plain sans stripe of open curves. And a body size a notch up would suit this pair, which is made for brief reading.
gen-fs-rosaline-plus-jakarta-sans: Rosaline throws bold downstrokes against hairline upstrokes, flowing like a pen-written hand. Plus Jakarta Sans draws monoline round letters like bent wire and does the steady work, while Rosaline is better kept brief.
gen-fs-segment-fs-erode: Commanding Segment spreads wide gaps between its letters, while Erode's text serif keeps shallow ascenders under a tall middle band. Its gentle stroke ebb stays easy for a paragraph or two.
